# Siegel Family Endowment

> A forward-thinking philanthropic organization investing in AI governance, workforce development, and digital infrastructure to shape technology's positive impact on society.

The Siegel Family Endowment is a private foundation led by David Siegel that focuses on three core areas: learning ecosystems, workforce development, and digital infrastructure. The endowment emphasizes inquiry-driven grantmaking, research partnerships, and collaborative funding with other major foundations to address technology's social implications.

## Key Topics

- AI governance
- Workforce development
- Digital infrastructure
- Learning ecosystems
- Technology ethics
- Grantmaking approach
- Research fellows
- Education technology
- Social impact
- Collaborative funding
- Rural broadband
- Worker rights
- Civic knowledge
- Emerging technologies

- [Our Chairman](https://www.siegelendowment.org/about-us/our-chairman): David Siegel biography, technology ethics vision, and grantmaking philosophy

## Grantmaking & Focus Areas

- [Our Interest Areas](https://www.siegelendowment.org/our-interest-areas): Primary philanthropic focus areas: learning, work, and infrastructure
- [Learning](https://www.siegelendowment.org/our-interest-areas/learning): Learning ecosystems and education technology grantmaking strategy
- [Workforce](https://www.siegelendowment.org/our-interest-areas/work): Workforce development, AI ethics, and worker rights grantmaking focus
- [Infrastructure](https://www.siegelendowment.org/our-interest-areas/infrastructure): Digital infrastructure, civic knowledge, and community-driven design priorities
- [What We Fund](https://www.siegelendowment.org/what-we-fund): Grantmaking approach, funding priorities, and proposal process details
- [Grantees](https://www.siegelendowment.org/grantees): Directory of grant recipients and funded organizations across focus areas

## Research & Insights

- [Research](https://www.siegelendowment.org/research): Research strategy, fellows program, and technology-social science initiatives
- [Fellows Program](https://www.siegelendowment.org/research/fellows): Siegel Research Fellowship program and 2024-2025 cohort of fellows
- [Research Advisory Council](https://www.siegelendowment.org/research/advisory-council): Advisory council leadership and thought leaders guiding research strategy
- [Insights Hub](https://www.siegelendowment.org/insights): Insights hub with case studies, research publications, and grantee feedback
- [Research Insights](https://www.siegelendowment.org/insights-category/research): Research insights hub featuring AI policy, labor markets, and governance
- [Shaping AI on Rural Terms](https://www.siegelendowment.org/insights/shaping-ai-on-rural-terms-infrastructure-ownership-and-the-question-of-who-captures-the-gains): Research article on rural AI infrastructure, broadband access, and digital equity
